description: Behavior corpus for flow-dev input-mode handling (verify-skill A2). Each case states the input shape and the expected entry decision — distinguishes orchestrated vs direct entry vs bounce, which trigger-eval.json (upstream routing only) cannot.

cases.prompt: flow orchestrator dispatches a 3-task decomposed list with test plans and issue paths under docs/ticket/
cases.expected: orchestrated entry: consume the task list as-is; no self-generation; per-task loop over 3 tasks

cases.prompt: Fix: NAS SMB share drops connection on rename; repro script attached reproduces 10/10
cases.expected: direct entry: self-generate one-task list (description, test plan = repro passes, create docs/ticket/<slug>.md), then normal per-task loop; no converge/decompose dispatch

cases.prompt: Implement docs/ticket/2026-07-24-example.md (Status: ready-for-agent, acceptance criteria present)
cases.expected: direct entry: one-task list from the existing ticket; do not create a duplicate ticket file

cases.prompt: Rename config key foo.bar to foo.baz across the repo, update the one test that asserts it
cases.expected: direct entry: single grounded task, self-generated ticket; stacked PR workflow still applies
bounce to flow: spec skips converge but still needs decompose; flow-dev must NOT self-decompose a spec

cases.prompt: We should probably make the dashboard feel snappier
cases.expected: bounce to flow (converge): ungrounded, no acceptance criterion

cases.prompt: Sometimes uploads fail, not sure when or why
cases.expected: bounce to diagnosing-bugs: produce a repro first, then re-enter flow-dev

cases.prompt: All three stacked PRs are approved, merge the stack
